name: paper-radar
description: The administrative memory: drop contracts, policies, warranties and IDs in any language; paper-radar extracts renewal dates, costs and cancellation windows deterministically, keeps a private local ledger, warns before notice windows close, drafts cancellations, and exports deadlines to your calendar. Fully offline — designed to work efficiently with local models.

paper.description: Radar over tracked documents: what renews, what it costs, how to cancel before the window closes

interface.shortDescription: Never miss a renewal or cancellation window again.
interface.longDescription: Renewals, warranties, subscriptions and document deadlines tracked from the documents themselves — not from typing dates into an app. Drop a contract or policy (PDF via pdftotext, or pasted text); deterministic Spanish/English parsers extract the renewal date, cost, periodicity and the cancellation-notice window; a strict local ledger derives notice deadlines automatically. The radar warns when a window is about to close ('cancel by Sep 4 or it renews for another year'), drafts the cancellation notice in the document's language, totals your recurring costs, and exports everything to your calendar. Fully offline and local: no network tools, no uploads, and the compact structured candidates keep it efficient even on small local models.
